title: Standalone explorer shell
responsibility: Hosts the explorer using browser history outside a framework router.

inputs.name: HarnessShell.base
inputs.description: Required URL path prefix that is removed from `location.pathname` when the relative route is initialized and prepended to a route during navigation. The component does not validate or normalize the prefix, so it must match the beginning of the browser pathname for route extraction to work.

inputs.name: HarnessShell.links
inputs.description: Optional links with a string label and href, defaulting to an empty list, that the shell forwards to `HarnessConsole`. The shell does not inspect or transform the links.

outputs.name: HarnessShell
outputs.description: The rendered shell supplies `HarnessConsole` with `base`, the current relative `path`, `navigate`, `links`, and `ExplorerContent` as `content`. The path starts as `location.pathname.slice(base.length) + location.search`, changes after push or replace navigation, and is refreshed on `popstate`; the component does not validate or normalize `base`.
